ambiguity_rules: Read authorized sources first; ask only for facts that materially change the output.

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: Setting up a new Odoo instance for a company for the first time.; Configuring multi-currency or multi-company accounting.; Troubleshooting tax calculation or fiscal position mapping errors.; Creating payment terms for installment billing (e.g., Net 30, 50% upfront).

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: 1. **Activate**: Mention `@odoo-accounting-setup` and describe your accounting scenario.; 2. **Configure**: Receive step-by-step Odoo menu navigation with exact field values.; 3. **Validate**: Get a checklist to verify your setup is complete and correct.

forbidden_actions: Ledger/account mutation, payment, filing, signature, external communications, configuration change
Invented company facts, approval, law, tax rule or accounting policy
verification_steps: 1. Establish business process, entities, currencies, fiscal periods, reporting, controls and version facts by founder interview/approved owner data. 2. Read existing Odoo configuration through granted `odoo__search_records`, `odoo__count_records`, `odoo__read_records` only; use bounded filters and omit sensitive fields. 3. Compare observed setup with explicit business requirements and identify functional gaps; do not guess model names/fields/version behavior. 4. Draft requirements, acceptance cases, migration dependencies and expected reports for Eric to configure/validate. 5. Keep configuration, imports, chart mutations and module installation out of this task.
Business acceptance requirements are separated from Odoo technical implementation; current native schema is obeyed.
Cite source refs and report uncertainty; no balancing plugs.
completion_criteria: Task-specific output is complete within declared scope
Material calculations reproduce and source refs are present
Remaining context and owner decisions are explicit
known_limitations: Structural checks do not qualify runtime behavior
Source originals are not executable workflow instructions
Current law or Odoo behavior must be verified at point of use

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
